summary.name: Disk Drill
summary.one_liner: Disk Drill is a data recovery app for macOS (and iOS/Android devices) that scans storage devices to recover deleted or lost files and partitions, with a free edition and a paid PRO version.
use_cases: Recover files deleted from a Mac's internal or external drive
Restore data from a formatted or unrecognized drive
Recover photos from an SD card or camera
Get back messages or contacts from an iPhone or iPad
Recover files from Time Machine backups or local snapshots
Recover data from a failing or unreadable disk
summary.what_it_does: Disk Drill scans internal and external drives, cameras, phones, memory cards, RAID arrays and disk images to find recoverable files and lost partitions. It lists found files so the user can preview them before restoring. It can reconstruct over 400 file types using several binary recovery methods and can parse Time Machine backup disks and local snapshots. It also includes free extra disk tools such as duplicate finding, backup, macOS installer creation and disk health monitoring. Recent versions are said to support Intel and Apple silicon Macs.
notable: Parses Time Machine backup disks and scans local Time Machine snapshots
Recovers lost partitions and data from formatted drives
Free extra disk tools included (duplicate finder, backup, installer creation, disk health)
Listed in awesome-mac under Data Recovery Tools
caveats: Recovering all deleted files requires the paid PRO version; the free version scans and previews
Android recovery is stated for rooted devices only
Requires low-level access and installs its own kernel extension (kext)
Older macOS versions need Disk Drill 1.x-5.x
